packs.title: 2027 Hyundai Kona
packs.content:
The Hyundai Kona is the brand’s entry crossover SUV, positioned below the Tucson in its SUV lineup. It is designed for buyers who want a smaller, more urban-friendly SUV with available gasoline and electric powertrains. Kona Electric is the battery-electric version of Kona and is part of Hyundai’s EV lineup alongside IONIQ 5 and IONIQ 9.

 

Key facts

Vehicle type: Compact SUV
Powertrain: 2.0L MPI Atkinson Engine with Intelligent Variable transmission, and 1.6T-GDI Startstream engine with 8-Speed automatic transmission
Drive layout: Standard FWD; Optional HTRAC AWD (all trims)
Charging architecture: Four USB-C Charge ports 15W
Maximum output: 190 hp / 195 lb-ft (1.6T-GDI Smartstream engine)
Trims referenced: SE, SEL Sport, SEL Premium, Limited

Powertrain overview

The 2027 Kona offers two gasoline powertrains: a 147-hp 2.0L Atkinson-cycle four-cylinder paired with an Intelligent Variable Transmission (IVT), and a more powerful 190-hp 1.6L turbocharged four-cylinder paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission. Both engines are available with standard front-wheel drive or optional HTRAC all-wheel drive, allowing buyers to choose between efficiency-focused and performance-oriented configurations.

 

Performance highlights

Maximum power: 190 HP @ 6000 rpm
Maximum torque: 195 lb-ft @ 1700-4500 rpm
Drivetrain: FWD standard; HTRAC, AWD available
Transmission: Intelligent Variable Transmission and 8-Speed Automatic

 

Safety & driver assistance

The 2027 Kona comes standard with Hyundai SmartSense safety technologies, including Forward Collision-Avoidance Assist with Pedestrian/Cyclist Detection, Lane Keeping Assist, Lane Following Assist, Blind-Spot Collision Warning, Rear Cross-Traffic Collision-Avoidance Assist, and Smart Cruise Control with Stop & Go. New safety enhancements include Junction Turning and Direct Oncoming collision avoidance, haptic steering wheel alerts, and upgraded second-row seatbelt systems. The Limited trim adds advanced features such as Surround View Monitor, Blind-Spot View Monitor, Parking Distance Warning, Parking Collision-Avoidance Assist-Reverse, and Remote Smart Parking Assist.

 

Dimensions & utility

Wheelbase: 104.7 in
Overall length: 171.3 in
Overall width: 71.9 in
Overall height: FWD: 17/18-inch wheels: 62.2 (62.4), 19-inch wheels: 62.4 (62.6) AWD: 17/18-inch wheels: 63.2 (63.4), 19-inch wheels: 63.4 (63.6
Cargo volume: 25.5 cu. ft
Coefficient of drag: 0.302

 

Trim overview

The 2027 Kona lineup ranges from the entry-level SE and sporty SEL Sport to the more upscale SEL Premium, while the Limited serves as the fully loaded flagship with premium comfort, technology, and safety features.
